pins.name: R1
pins.notes: Row 1. Rows are read with INPUT_PULLUP. Adafruit 3x4 keypads use another pin order

pins.name: C1
pins.notes: Column 1. Columns are driven LOW one at a time

sources.title: Arduino Keypad library (Mark Stanley, Alexander Brevig)
